config.title: Services
config.description: Services reporting server request metrics; the data lists each service with its request rate

dataSourceConfig.query:
WITH (
    total = sum by (service.name) (label_copy(rate({__name__=~"http_server_request_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_milliseconds_count|rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count"}[5m]), "service_name", "service.name")),
    failed = sum by (service.name) (label_copy(rate({__name__=~"http_server_request_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_milliseconds_count", http.response.status_code=~"5.." or __name__=~"http_server_request_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_milliseconds_count", http_response_status_code=~"5.." or __name__=~"http_server_request_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_milliseconds_count", http.status_code=~"5.." or __name__=~"http_server_request_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_milliseconds_count", http_status_code=~"5.." or __name__="rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count", rpc.grpc.status_code=~"2|4|12|13|14|15" or __name__="rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count", rpc_grpc_status_code=~"2|4|12|13|14|15"}[5m]), "service_name", "service.name")),
    pct = 100 * (failed or 0 * total) / total,
    sec = sum by (service.name, le) (label_copy(rate({__name__=~"http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket|http_server_duration_seconds_bucket"}[5m]), "service_name", "service.name")),
    ms = sum by (service.name, le) (label_copy(rate({__name__=~"http_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket|rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket"}[5m]), "service_name", "service.name")),
    pms(q) = 1000 * histogram_quantile(q, sec) or histogram_quantile(q, ms)
)
total

config.title: Service Health
config.description: Error rate per service: red above 5%, amber above 1%

dataSourceConfig.query:
WITH (
    total = sum by (service.name) (label_copy(rate({__name__=~"http_server_request_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_milliseconds_count|rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count"}[5m]), "service_name", "service.name")),

    pct = 100 * (failed or 0 * total) / total,
    sec = sum by (service.name, le) (label_copy(rate({__name__=~"http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket|http_server_duration_seconds_bucket"}[5m]), "service_name", "service.name")),
    ms = sum by (service.name, le) (label_copy(rate({__name__=~"http_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket|rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket"}[5m]), "service_name", "service.name")),
    pms(q) = 1000 * histogram_quantile(q, sec) or histogram_quantile(q, ms)
